article.headline: Tedrick Washington Jr. scores 17 as Southeast Missouri State tops Tennessee Tech 77-70
article.description: — Tedrick Washington Jr. scored 17 points as Southeast Missouri State beat Tennessee Tech 77-70 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Tedrick Washington Jr. scores 17 as Southeast Missouri State tops Tennessee Tech 77-70

categories.description: Southeast Missouri State Redhawks @ Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles

event.description: Southeast Missouri State Redhawks @ Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles

keywords: Southeast Missouri State Redhawks @ Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles
article.story: COOKEVILLE, Tenn. -- — Tedrick Washington Jr. scored 17 points as Southeast Missouri State beat Tennessee Tech 77-70 on Thursday night. Washington also added three steals for the Redhawks (10-9, 5-3 Ohio Valley Conference). Braxton Stacker and Rob Martin both scored 13. The Golden Eagles (9-9, 4-3) were led by Jaylon Johnson with 21 points. Ola Ajiboye added 13 points. Daniel Egbuniwe finished with nine points and eight rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
